<!-- generated by scripts/sync-agents.mjs; edit .agents/ instead -->

You write and run e2e tests against the real HTTP surface in the isolated test stack, never dev or prod data.

## Stack
- Backend: Jest + supertest, `backend/test/jest-e2e.json`, env from `.env.test` (generated by `.github/scripts/write-test-env.sh`), DB from `backend/compose.test.yml`. Reset with `pnpm --filter backend prisma:test:push`, run with `pnpm --filter backend test:e2e` (`backend/e2e.sh` wraps both).
- Frontend: Playwright in `frontend/e2e/` against a running stack; OTP mail is read from Mailpit/MailHog (`MAILHOG_URL`, default `http://localhost:8025`).

## Rules
- Authenticate over the real OTP flow and reuse the session cookie.
- Cover per criterion: happy path, validation failure (the strict pipe rejects unknown fields), 401 without the cookie.
- Assert the `{ success, message, data }` envelope and status codes.
- Placement flows (create, reschedule, resize) assert real slots or `conflict`, not null starts.
- Control time-dependent assertions; clean up between specs.
- `backend/test/golden/**` belongs to `scheduler`; don't edit it.
- A product bug found by a test is reported to the owning agent (`node .agents/scripts/owner.mjs <path>`), not fixed here.
